messages:
Irina: Heads-up — starting RBAC refactor for Console. Goal: consolidate viewer/editor/admin, add explicit 'project_audit' permission, and tighten UI permission-gating. Need a migration checklist, DB script, audit-log schema changes, and KMS rotation impact notes.
Samir: +1. What's the mapping for legacy/custom roles? Any implicit perms we should watch (API keys / deploy tokens)?
Irina: Main risk is legacy API keys still carrying old 'editor' claims in JWT payloads. Plan: compatibility shim for 3 releases, and migration that emits 'rbac_change' audit events. Proposed mapping: old_viewer->viewer, old_editor->editor_v2, old_admin->admin. Custom roles keep explicit permissions.
Laura: Can we do a dry-run migration per org (preview diff)? Also need UI warnings for users/orgs that will lose access so support isn't flooded.
Mike: For DB migration sketch (needs review):
```sql
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
UPDATE role_assignments
SET role = CASE
  WHEN role = 'old_editor' THEN 'editor_v2'
  WHEN role = 'old_viewer' THEN 'viewer'
  ELSE role END
WHERE org_id = $1;
COMMIT;
```
Also include mapping for service accounts and tokens.
Sasha: Audit log proposal: new event type 'rbac_change' with fields: actor, target, before_permissions (list), after_permissions (list), reason, request_id, timestamp. Index request_id + target_user (hashed) for lookups. Consider storing full payload in KMS envelope.
devsec-bot: Reminder — KMS key rotation will re-encrypt envelopes; schedule maintenance window. Flagged related vuln CVE-2025-1101 in triage notes: ensure no permission-escalation path during rotation.
Irina: For UI gating: server must enforce effective-permissions check; UI should both disable and show tooltip (not only hide) for a11y. Telemetry: count 'disabled_click' and 'forbidden_api_calls' to detect mismatches.
Samir: Triage checklist I'm creating: 1) legacy API keys with old editor claims; 2) role-inheritance bug after org-split that may leak perms; 3) missing request_id on ~2% of audit events. I'll file tickets and link here.
Laura: KMS envelope question — do we store any plaintext to allow fast search? Prefer no. Suggest storing hashed indices (user_id, request_id) and full payload only encrypted with KMS.
Mike: Rollout plan: canary 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100%. Monitor permission-denied spikes, support tickets, and audit volume. Feature-flagged fallback to old-role-behavior for quick rollback. I'll draft a rollback playbook.
Sasha: I'll update the role matrix doc and add integration tests for UI gating + API token introspection. Also add unit tests to ensure button disabled state aligns with server errors.
Irina: Can someone run the vuln triage on the recent high-severity alert and confirm linkage to the RBAC changes? @Samir
Samir: On it — will post result by EOD.
devsec-bot: Deploy bot: migration job scheduled in staging for 2025-03-10 03:00 UTC. :rocket:
Irina: Thanks all — assigning owners on the tickets. Will follow up with the dry-run export and sample audit events in this thread.
